scoring.match_rule: An LLM-extracted dimension matches a GT entry if (a) kind matches OR is a compatible alias, (b) numerical value within ±0.05 (mm precision), (c) tolerances within ±0.05 if specified. Compound counterbore annotations (e.g. '4 × Ø15 THRU ⌴ Ø26 ▽ 16') are split into hole pattern + counterbore diameter + counterbore depth; the model gets credit for each independently. A single physical feature dimensioned in more than one view is counted once; distinct dimensions that happen to share a value (e.g. the 240 base width and the 240 axial length) are counted separately. ISO tolerance classes (H7) and 'TYP.' notes are recorded in 'as_drawn' but are not required for a numerical match.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = recall and precision >= 0.85; Pass = both >= 0.70.
